headline: Walchandnagar Industries: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure by Chakor L. Doshi under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Chakor L. Doshi has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Walchandnagar Industries Limited, a disclosure requirement triggered when shareholding crosses regulatory thresholds.
detail: Chakor L. Doshi submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when a person's shareholding in a listed company reaches or crosses statutory thresholds (5% initially, then 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, and 90%). The filing indicates a material change in shareholding pattern and potential change of control. Exact consideration, percentage acquired, and timeline for completion are not specified in the headline disclosure and require review of the full form filed with the exchange.
